title: Malaysian Tofu Curry
description: A spicy and flavorful curry made with tofu and warm spices, inspired by the cuisine of Malaysia.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and warm spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tofu and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the lime juice and brown sugar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad.
